**Nvidia** had the higher gross margin in fiscal 2025, by about 6.2 percentage points.

- **Nvidia** (fiscal year ended January 26, 2025): gross profit of about $97.9B on revenue of about $130.5B gives a gross margin of about 74.99%.
- **Microsoft** (fiscal year ended June 30, 2025): gross margin of about $193.9B on revenue of about $281.7B gives a gross margin of about 68.82%.

The difference is 74.99% − 68.82% ≈ 6.17 percentage points, which rounds to 6.2.

The figures are from memory, not looked up, so treat them as close estimates.
